Name: Malchiah
Summary: Malchiah, son of Hammelech, owned the dungeon in the prison court into which Jeremiah was let down with cords until he sank in the mire.
KeyStory: Jeremiah was let down with cords into the dungeon of Malchiah the king's son, where there was no water but mire, and he sank in the mire.
LifeLesson: A dungeon with an owner's name attached to it reminds us that cruelty is always somebody's property.
RelatedEvents: Ezra Reads the Law; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
